about.title: About LLMCompare
about.backgroundDesc: LLMCompare has evolved from a data collection site into a model selection assistant — no longer just displaying data for 60+ global AI models, but helping you find the right model for your needs.
about.backgroundMission: Browse by use case (coding, agent, value, reasoning) to see top-4 recommendations. Each detail page shows recommendation tags and similar alternatives. The Compare page provides a quick verdict to guide your decision.
about.backgroundContribute: Found an error or want to add a model? Submit via
about.filterDesc: Models are sourced from Artificial Analysis global dataset filtered by three tiers: Large, Frontier, or Intelligence >= 30 (includes cost-effective mid/small models). Same-series legacy models (e.g., Qwen3.5, GLM-4) are automatically excluded. Domestic and international models share a unified pipeline. Active set defaults to models released within 180 days (adjustable via pipeline.py --max-age-days). Arena rankings and OpenRouter popularity data are overlaid. Coverage includes major vendors, ranked by intelligence score.
about.sourceDesc: Artificial Analysis is an authoritative LLM evaluation org providing standardized benchmarks. Its Intelligence Index combines MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, and other benchmarks to assess reasoning, coding, and math capabilities.
about.priceDetail: Official pricing sourced from model vendor websites. Detail pages show both official pricing and OpenRouter pricing. The table uses OpenRouter pricing for consistent comparison. Updated weekly.
about.arenaDesc: lmarena.ai (formerly Chatbot Arena) is the world's largest crowdsourced LLM leaderboard, generating ELO scores based on blind human evaluation. We collect its text, coding, and vision leaderboard data as a reference for real-world usage experience.
about.orDesc: The world's largest LLM API routing platform, providing unified API access and weekly token consumption rankings. We collect its public weekly rankings and API pricing — volume reflects real-world usage, pricing reflects market rates.
about.disclaimerDesc: This field guide is for reference only. Model performance varies by use case and may differ from the data presented.

product.dataCompletenessDesc: Weighted completeness score based on 18 core fields including benchmarks, speed, pricing, and Arena rankings

tip.intelligence: Artificial Analysis composite score based on MMLU, HumanEval, MATH and other benchmarks. Range 0-100, higher is better.
tip.coding: Coding ability score based on code generation benchmarks like HumanEval. Range 0-100, higher is better.
tip.agentic: Agent capability score measuring the model's ability to autonomously complete multi-step tasks. Range 0-100, higher is better.
tip.mmluPro: Massive Multitask Language Understanding benchmark — measures broad knowledge across 57 subjects. Range 0-100, higher is better.
tip.speed: Tokens Per Second — how many tokens the model processes per second. Higher is faster.
tip.p5: P5 speed — the processing speed of the fastest 5% of samples, reflecting peak performance.
tip.p95: P95 speed — the processing speed of the slowest 5% of samples, reflecting worst-case performance.
tip.ttft: Time to First Token — delay from sending a request to receiving the first token. Lower is better.
tip.e2e: End-to-End Latency — total time to complete a full request. Lower is better.
tip.blended: Weighted average of input and output pricing, calculated at a typical 60% input / 40% output ratio.
tip.parameters: Number of model parameters (B = Billion). Generally larger models are more capable but cost more to run.
tip.orWeeklyTokens: Real weekly token consumption on OpenRouter, reflecting real-world usage popularity.
tip.arenaVotes: Cumulative blind human evaluation votes from lmarena.ai (Chatbot Arena). More votes = more reliable ranking.
tip.elo: ELO rating from paired battle results on lmarena.ai. Typical range 1200-1600, higher ranks higher.
tip.contextWindow: Maximum number of tokens the model can process in a single request (input + output combined). Larger = can handle longer content.
tip.gpqa: Graduate-level Q&A benchmark — tests PhD-level knowledge across domains. Higher is better.
tip.hle: Hard Language Understanding benchmark — tests difficult reasoning and comprehension. Higher is better.
